identity.title: Absorbance measurement of a prepared plate

semantics.purpose: Record raw absorbance values for a prepared plate without converting them into viability, concentration or cell number.
preconditions: The plate is prepared for the selected colorimetric readout.
Blank wells are present on the same plate when the assay requires background correction.
The plate format and lid height are compatible with the reader.

outputs.description: The same physical plate after optical measurement.
Raw absorbance matrix with wavelength and instrument metadata.

sample_transitions.note: Measurement is optical and non-consumptive; the plate is not returned to a pre-reagent state.

parameters.label: Measurement wavelength
parameters.description: Selected for the assay chemistry; this module supplies no default wavelength.

evidence.citation: Thermo Scientific Multiskan SkyHigh specification sheet COL33729 0720

parameters.label: Plate format
parameters.description: Must match the physical plate and the instrument profile.

evidence.citation: Thermo Scientific Multiskan SkyHigh specification sheet COL33729 0720

parameters.label: Blank well identifiers
parameters.description: Record same-plate blank wells; subtraction is a downstream operation.

evidence.locator: Assay procedure: blank and background correction

completion_checks.description: Plate is seated within the instrument plate-height limit.
Every addressed well has a raw value and the wavelength is recorded.

controls.label: Same-plate blank wells
controls.purpose: Record reagent and medium background on the same plate; do not auto-subtract.

decision_points.question: Are the raw values within the reader's linear range?
decision_points.evidence: Blank wells, known dilution, and the profile linearity limit.
decision_points.continue_if: Values are within the documented linear range.
decision_points.stop_if: Values are saturated or below the detection limit; dilute or repeat upstream.

failure_modes.symptom: Outlier absorbance in otherwise replicated wells.
failure_modes.action: Re-seat or de-bubble the plate; record the affected wells.
Dilute or repeat the upstream assay; do not clip the value.

readout.derived: Blank-corrected or standard-curve result, computed downstream.
readout.not_implied: Viability, cell number, concentration or biological effect.

evidence.citation: Thermo Scientific Multiskan SkyHigh specification sheet COL33729 0720
